title: Complexity Theory Core: Canonical Sound Gödelized Computation Model
description: Provides the canonical sound computation model for P vs NP formalizations, fixing the soundness flaw in PNPBarriersLegacy.lean. Programs are natural numbers (Gödel codes); computation is via an opaque universal function Φ preventing trivial solver construction. Defines P, NP, coNP, EXP, oracle computation, and NP-completeness. 5 axioms for the opaque universal function. 16 theorems.

meta.author: Lean Genius Research
meta.assumptions: 5 axioms for universal computation function Φ and its time-bounded properties.

overview.historicalContext: The key design principle: programs are countable (indexed by ℕ) but decision problems (ℕ → Bool) are uncountable, preventing trivial solver construction.
overview.problemStatement: Provide a sound computation model for complexity-theoretic formalizations.
overview.proofStrategy: Opaque universal function Φ : ℕ → ℕ → Bool; oracle queries tracked in step count; P, NP, EXP defined via Φ.
keyInsights: **P_subset_NP**: Every polynomial-time decidable problem is also polynomial-time verifiable
**Assumptions**: 5 axioms for universal computation function Φ and its time-bounded properties.
